one_line: Open-source CLI that hunts down social media accounts by username across 400+ networks.
auth_notes: No API, no authentication - it is a local open-source CLI/Python tool that performs unauthenticated HTTP checks against social sites
self_serve_notes: Free and open-source (MIT); install via pipx/pip, Docker or distro packages and run locally - no account or credentials needed

api_surface.breadth_estimate: No public API; CLI with per-site checks and JSON/CSV/XLSX output (uses upstream data.json site list)

existing_mcp.note: No official MCP server; as a local CLI it could be wrapped in a custom MCP server if desired

blocker: No API to integrate against - Sherlock is a self-hosted CLI tool, not a SaaS with an API surface

evidence.note: fetched GitHub README confirms CLI usage, install methods, 400+ networks, MIT license

agent_notes: Not a SaaS; integration would mean wrapping the CLI locally, not calling an external API.
